what: A background-colored mask covers each word in a line, then shrinks from 1 → 0 on its right edge as the axis and lifts to reveal the word — each word .2s later, short symbols (×·=) is half length (.15s) with cubic-bezier(.75,0,.25,1). Hero ‹word × word = Opens the Logo phrase one character at a time, as if stamping it out

options.trigger: load (default) — delay seconds after opening · scroll — once when the top edge reaches 80% of the screen
options.delay: When the first word starts to clear (seconds), default 1
options.dur: Duration for one word to clear (s), default .3
options.--fx-cover: Veil color (via style), default --kf-bg — must match the panel background for the text to hide
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Words to be cleared — at least one required. data-dur=".15" Changes the length of only that word (symbols, short words)

note: The mask covers .1em larger on all sides than the word (so the letter ends don’t show through). The original runs a CSS animation (barSlide) per word at 1 · 1.2 · 1.4 · 1.6s, the logo mask at 2s, and the one-line intro below at 3s .5s, each revealed separately. For such lines, attach one more of this part and match it with delay
